title: Nevers to Revol, Aug-Oct 1593, BnF fr. 3985 and fr. 3986, in the Court symbol cipher no. 60 (catalogue item 21, part)

steps.what: Gallica full-resolution canvases of fr. 3985, 3986, 3995 fetched; items mapped to folios.
Revol letters found to be in the Court key no. 60, not no. 46; the 27 Aug copy is in clear.
Key no. 60 transcribed in full from fr. 3995 ff. 109-111 and checked on the interlined King's letter of 7 Oct.
f. 146v and f. 157v transcribed and decoded; anchors only, copyist's cursive forms block the rest.
Instruction of 31 Aug found in print (Memoires de Nevers ii) and interlined in fr. 3985; glyph atlas begun.
Outside input, issue #32 (tunarob): 14 proposed key no. 60 corrections, a 4/2+ tag split, transcription of fr. 3985 f. 88r-v and a manual partial reading of f. 88r (LLM-assisted).

Each key correction checked on full-resolution fr. 3995 f. 109 and f. 111: 10 confirmed and adopted (b = o-, c flag, i hook+, o \\, m ɱ, u 2+, ‡/‡-loop, ♀ = u, ∩+ = g, o-o = c, o+o = y), 2 rejected (be, # in compounds); tags ſ+/4+/4+b/4/2+/n+ split.
f. 146v and f. 157v re-tagged and re-decoded with the corrected key; unresolved 29/204 and 68/226 tokens, no new reading.
f. 88r R5 'de absolution' (needs the corrected b), R6 oo+ le Roy and f++ qu'il, checked on the image; Tomokiyo's 'conversion' rejected (needs q = c).
f88/shuffle_control.py: longest lexicon word over 86 R3-R6 tokens = 10 letters (absolution); 0/5000 token permutations reach it, P = 0.0002.

Split from nevers1593 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): key no. 60 and the Revol letters are their own entry; fr. 3986 no. 68 (7 Oct), listed as not located in the first session, identified as f. 146v from Tomokiyo's list.

outcome.method_basis: Key no. 60, the Court cipher given to Nevers (BnF fr. 3995 ff. 108-111), identified for these letters by Tomokiyo, transcribed here and corrected from issue #32; applied to the transcribed passages, it gives words only on f. 88r (de absolution, le Roy, qu'il) and anchors on f. 146v.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No denominator: three of six passages are untranscribed and ct_3986_f146v.txt / ct_3986_f157v.txt mix clear cursive with cipher. f. 88r: three words from 86 tokens; on f. 146v and f. 157v the tagged tokens decode to table values (29 of 204 and 68 of 226 unresolved) but do not read.
outcome.notes: Read in part only on f. 88r; the blocker so far is palaeographic (the copyist's cursive forms), and three passages are still to transcribe (Status: in progress).

gaps.item: fr. 3986 f. 146v, Revol 7 Oct 1593 (nine cipher lines, key no. 60)
gaps.detail: transcribed at 2.4-3.2x but copyist's cursive forms map to two or three table entries; atlas pass started, not finished
faded; clear cursive and cipher run together, cipher extent not yet segmented

gaps.item: fr. 3985 f. 88r (21 Aug) - read in part (de absolution, le Roy, qu'il); rest of R3-R6
gaps.detail: bitonal microfilm copy in the copyist's cursive, the contributor's transcription has variant readings at about one sign in six and no colour scan exists
transcribed by the contributor (116 units, issue #32), no reading under key no. 60; not re-transcribed here
located and cut but never transcribed; key no. 60 is fully in hand

credits.note: Court key no. 60 (fr. 3995 ff. 108-111); the office's interlinear decipherments of fr. 3986 f. 151 and the 31 Aug Instruction as cribs
identified key no. 60 for these letters; henryiv2.htm lists every letter in no. 60
issue #32: corrections to key no. 60 (10 of 12 adopted), tag split, partial reading of f. 88r
issue #32: transcription of fr. 3985 f. 88r-v (116 units of f. 88v)

prior.where: Tomokiyo (cryptiana henryiv2.htm) decoded three words of f. 146v (l'absolution, a la verite, interest) and guessed 'conversion' on f. 88r

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue.
